# Version 4.150.5
> **RAW decoding retired** · Released September 29, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.150.5) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.150.5)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.150.5/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1.5/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.150.5 retires built-in RAW and DNG decoding while preserving the public format enum.

## Breaking Changes

- **Use a separate RAW or DNG decoder** — Built-in RAW/DNG development and PIEX extraction of embedded JPEG previews are disabled; no replacement decoder is included. Decode those containers with another library and pass supported pixels or images to SkiaSharp. SKEncodedImageFormat.Dng remains value 10 for compatibility but no longer indicates decoding support. Standalone JPEG decoding is unchanged. ([#5184](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5184))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1.5

No HarfBuzzSharp binding changes shipped in this release — it rebuilds the same HarfBuzz as the previous line.
